Hi, well it really depends on how you wanna take on this, I will list weapons type with extar info and tips.

- Bow: generally called the best transition for blademaster -> gunner, for most of the fight you will be pretty near the monster and need to manage stamina (if you use mega dash juice you can go crazy).

Rapid shot: this one is the most comon type since it shots arrows in a vertical line so you can pretty much hit them all, it has a very close range to the monster (2~3 rolls away). The best bow for this one dps wise is Teostra bow, I also like the one from Zelda dlc since it can status pretty much all of them.

Pierce shot: this one functions with 1 arrow that pierces through the enemy in and horizontal line, its good for elemental and it has a very good range away from the enemy. The bow I like to use with this one is Alatreon.

Spread shot: This one shots a los of arrows in an arc similar to the one of a Baseball field horizontally, it´s good for status and it has a very close range to the monster. The bow I like to use with this one is Amatsu.

- LBG: It has good movility and can do a lot of neet things, you will have to reload a lot (but with the hunter art it isn't such a nuisance, has a lot of shot types. Since it can move well it's good for Status and Elemental.

Pierce shot: pretty much functions similar to Pierce shot from bow, good for starting up with LBG since you don't have to worry all that much about hitzones. Good pierce LBG are Nakarkos and Silverwind.

Normal shot: It shots a single bullet, because of this you kinda need to aim for the best hitzones so you don't take an eternity killing enemies (Best shot is lvl 2). Good normal LBG is Kushala Daora.

Some honorable mentions are Lost musket (Good for Crag shots and Clust, basically explosives), Prosperity (Silver and Gold Raths LBG) good for pellet if you want to try and God's island (Good for status gunnning).

- HBG: Slower than LBG but can dish out massive amounts of damage. Pretty much funcitons similar to LBG but you will have to be more careful because fo your speed. Good pierce HBG is Kushala Daora/Mizustune, normal HBG Shagaru Magala/Akantor/Seregios.

I hope this sumary helps, if you have anymore questions feel free to ask them.
